inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to renegotiate the 2009 agreement or face an indefinite nationwide strike. The government should honour its obligations, but no union has the right to make students and families pay for a dispute between adults. Universities exist to educate, not to serve as leverage in a standoff. Both sides must put duty and the future of young people ahead of brinkmanship and settle this before university life is disrupted again.
